summary: Shows loop_control index_var (2.5+) to expose the 0-indexed current loop index.
questions: How do I get the index of the current loop item?

answer_card.title: Tracking loop index with index_var
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ item }} with index {{ my_idx }}"
  loop: [apple, banana, pear]
  loop_control:
    index_var: my_idx
```

`index_var` is 0-indexed.
